title: Option Year Exercise Validity After Performance Lapse
scenario_text:
Context from Costpoint — Contract FA8726-21-C-0198:
Contract type: FFP | CLIN 0001 (base): Oct 2021 - Sep 2023 | CLIN 0002 (Option I): Oct 2023 - Sep 2024 | CLIN 0003 (Option II): Oct 2024 - Sep 2025 | PWS: Cyber threat intelligence analysis support. Option II exercise deadline per FAR 52.217-9 clause: Government must provide preliminary notice 60 days prior and exercise NLT Sep 30, 2024.

**Email — Subject: 'Option II Exercise — FA8726' (Aug 1, 2024)**
From: maj.reynolds@us.af.mil (Government CO)
To: pat.holloway@sentineldef.com
CC: contracts-fa8726@sentineldef.com

Ms. Holloway — This serves as preliminary written notice of the Government's intent to exercise Option II on FA8726-21-C-0198. Formal modification to follow.

— Maj. Reynolds, PCO

**Email — Subject: 'RE: RE: RE: Option II Mod Signature' (Oct 14, 2024)**
From: pat.holloway@sentineldef.com
To: maj.reynolds@us.af.mil

> On Oct 9, maj.reynolds wrote:
> > Mod is being routed for signature. Expect execution this week.
> > Apologies for the delay — our legal review took longer than expected.
>
> Pat — just to confirm, you're continuing performance pending mod execution, correct?

Maj. Reynolds — confirmed. Team has maintained continuity of performance per your Aug 1 preliminary notice. No gap in deliverables. We treated your notice as authorization to proceed pending the bilateral mod.

**Costpoint — Labor Charging History (Project FA8726-OPT2):**
Charges begin: Oct 1, 2024 | Mod P00004 (Option II exercise) signed: Oct 18, 2024 | Total unbilled labor Oct 1-17: $142,800.

**Teams — #sentinel-contracts-div2 (Oct 3, 2024, 9:15 AM)**
@pat.holloway: Anyone seen this before? FA8726 option mod still not signed, we started performance Oct 1 based on the preliminary notice alone.
@linda.castellano: That's a ratification situation if the mod doesn't come through. You have the CO's email authorizing continuation?
@pat.holloway: I have the Aug 1 preliminary notice and the Oct 9 email saying mod is being routed. Nothing explicitly saying 'authorized to proceed before execution.'
@linda.castellano: :grimacing: That's thin. The Aug letter says 'intent to exercise' — intent is not exercise.
@pat.holloway: Right but we've done this before on CENTCOM task orders. CO's verbal direction plus email trail has always been enough.
@linda.castellano: Verbal? Was there a call?
@pat.holloway: Yeah, Sep 27. Let me check if there are notes.
[No further replies]

**Google Calendar — 'FA8726 Option Discussion' (Sep 27, 2024, 3:00 PM)**
Organizer: pat.holloway@sentineldef.com
Attendees: maj.reynolds@us.af.mil (accepted), j.park@sentineldef.com (accepted)
Location: MS Teams call
Notes/Agenda: [empty — no attachment, no meeting notes linked]

**SharePoint — /contracts/FA8726/mods/P00004-option-exercise.pdf:**
Mod P00004 effective date: Oct 1, 2024 | Signed by Govt: Oct 18, 2024 | Signed by Sentinel: Oct 18, 2024 | Period of performance: Oct 1, 2024 - Sep 30, 2025.
question: If DCAA questions the $142,800 in labor costs charged between Oct 1-17 (before mod execution), what is the strongest justification for cost allowability?

contributor.name: Patricia Holloway
contributor.title: Contracting Officer
contributor.domain_expertise: FAR/DFARS compliance, contract modifications, option year exercises

choices: The CO's Aug 1 preliminary notice constitutes a constructive exercise of the option under FAR 52.217-9, authorizing performance from the option start date
The Sep 27 meeting between the CO and contractor, combined with the email trail, establishes authorized direction to proceed — but the lack of meeting notes weakens the position
Costs are unallowable because no written authorization existed prior to Oct 18; the preliminary notice only expressed intent, not direction to proceed
The mod P00004 retroactively sets the effective date to Oct 1, making all costs within the period of performance allowable regardless of signature date
